requirements: A retry with the same operation_id returns the same encrypted resumable result.
Concurrent duplicate requests create exactly one active credential.
Confirmation is idempotent and activates only the credential owned by the exact operation.
Cancellation is idempotent and terminally revokes an unconfirmed staged credential.
Plaintext credentials and enrollment codes are never persisted server-side.
Authenticated removal atomically revokes the trusted-device credential and deactivates its push registration.
Eligible pending notification jobs are cancelled in the same authoritative operation.
Stable operation replay returns the same terminal result after process or network restart.
The native client exchanges its device credential for a short-lived bearer only inside native memory.
The WebView receives sanitized identity and authorization claims but never credential, bearer, CSRF, cookie, or authentication headers.
Redirects and any method/path tuple outside the committed native registry are rejected.
